blocks.text: Miss Grand Uzbekistan 2023 Amaliya Shakirova, who has built a career and family in the Philippines, has once again taken the spotlight after being nominated for “Model of the Year” at The Iconic Awards 2026. Now a wife and mother who occasionally helps in her husband’s dental clinic Veneer Center, Shakirova embarked on a modeling career in the Philippines as early as 2015, and has appeared in several TV, print and outdoor campaigns, and even graced runways. She also threw her hat in beauty pageantry in 2022, and joined the Miss Cosmoworld pageant in Malaysia, where she finished first runner-up. The […]...
